notes.title: Update 1.03 (Action May Be Required)
notes.content:
A major issue was discovered at the end of Day One which may impact the players' save file(s). Any player who chose to save their game when prompted at the end of Day One (see image) will not be able to use that save file to progress to the next chapter (once it's available), as it will automatically return you to the title screen as soon as you open it.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42974145/6febb8162db3d588d9c7cb5f79b03b6c65304042.png
If this applies to you, and you don't have another back-up save file, I can send you a replacement save file that will allow you to start back just outside Khiona Castle with all characters at Level 11 and all available weapons and armor equipped (see image).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42974145/e85dc1eec2f9c613b14e612bd14d718c90c855f9.png
You can contact me on Steam Chat or email me directly (nytsud777@gmail.com) to receive this save file. I humbly apologize for any inconvenience this has caused. The feature at fault has now been removed with this update. Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.content:
A more standardized Day/Night system has been put into place. This includes standardized map tints and more specialized battle backgrounds.

We've also made more objects "smackable" with Mal's hammer throughout various parts of the map! Breaking stuff is fun!

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.content:
An issue was reported in the "Northern Gap" area where the player was able to walk through part of a fence. This has been resolved.
An issue was reported in the "Khiona Mountains" area where a transition from one map to another created a situation where the player could walk through an otherwise non-passable area. This has also been resolved.
